Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.util.*;
public class Solution
{
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		int num1=sc.nextInt();
		int num2=sc.nextInt();
		int min=num1<num2?num1:num2,i;
		for(i=min;i>=1;i--)
		    if((num1%i==0) && (num2%i==0))
		        break;
		System.out.println("GCD of "+num1+" and "+num2+" is "+i);
	}
}
